title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（黒瀨浩研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Kurose Hiroshi)
educationalGoal:
Based on the concrete knowledge of fundamental technologies, students acquire problem-solving skills related to computer & information engineering.
Students are also given opportunities to experience R&D activities related to concrete information technology and systems.
Through this process, students cultivate advanced abilities in the areas of problem setting, production process development, information gathering, communications, problem-solving in regional orientation, and making objective evaluations.
advice:
Investigate and examine the relationship between the technologies/services of interest and the following areas, and learn R&D methods through the development of programs and/or evaluation models.

The main target areas are as follows:
1. Designing, programming, and evaluating information systems
2. Exploring next-generation information systems such as content distribution and collaborative work applications
3. Improving stability, reliability, redundancy, and/or costs of information systems
4. Learning efficient programming using languages such as Python3, Perl6, Elixir, Haskell, Kotlin, or Scala
5. Expanding cooperation application programs between users
requiredKnowledge: Accumulation of results is important. Conduct self-checks, such as progress reports for each task.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set one-year achievement goals in relation to your chosen research.
Be able to set a specific production approach based on your set research concept.
Be able to use your acquired information engineering expertise to advance your design and analysis efforts.
Be able to cope with various problems that occur during the design and analysis process.
Be able to technically describe what you have accomplished in a convincing manner.

achievementLevels.ideal:
Be able to promote R&D activities smoothly according to the project plan (proposal) that you have created.

In the results, it is desirable that students be able to announce concrete results that are scientifically or technically recognized as novel, effective, and reliable.
achievementLevels.standard:
Be able to promote R&D activities smoothly according to the project plan (proposal) that you have created.

In the results, it is desirable that students be able to announce concrete results that are based in scientific and technical reality.
